name: Qwen3.8 Flash-Next UD-IQ3_XXS — own runtime, two GPUs

library.summary: Two B70 cards, target-verified MTP full-512 lab replay: writing 58.56–58.63 tok/s; reading a new 512-token prompt 75.88–75.97 tok/s. Full-output quality and portable replay pending.
library.benchmark_status: Two fresh full-512 suites: 58.557–58.632 tok/s, 512-input reading 75.884–75.973 tok/s. Oracle checks first 128 only; longer outputs repeat-exact. Approved 60.659520 record (packet187 V3 chain, 2026-10-22; was 58.798109) has a 128-token cap. Strict quality promotion pending.

hardware.note: 128 GiB lab host; 105411248128 bytes host memory available required; whole-host isolation, one user, native lab replay.

runtime.engine: Own Xe runtime (bundle 8 / packet165); arithmetic iq3-p49-split32-v1
runtime.compiler: Intel oneAPI compiler 2026.0; clean-source CPU compile and link passed; two-card rebuilt binary device qualification pending (only the one-card portable rebuild has been device-qualified, on 2026-10-22)
runtime.note: Measured packet165 identity, context 4096, BF16 KV; retained source/build evidence. Native benchmark only; no HTTP endpoint. Official MTP draft on rank 1; target-verified; banked rollback state.

project_patches.note: Own source runtime; no external runtime base or patch overlay.

contributors.validated_effect: Two fresh full-512 workload passes; first 128 output tokens oracle-exact, complete output repeat agreement; full-output quality remains pending.

text_measurements.scope: Each fresh load runs twelve cold suite prompts and one distinct 512-input-token prompt, with one user and a 4096-token context allocation. Decode is the class-balanced first-100-token generation rate across the twelve suite prompts. Each reading row measures one 512-input-token request on the warm runtime; native TTFT includes first-token work. Two-card TTFT starts after the request-state reset. The independent oracle covers only the first 128 output tokens; full-output quality remains pending.
